title.zh: PancakeSwap Proposes Raising LP Fee Share to 88% and Cutting Daily CAKE Emission
title.en: PancakeSwap Proposes Raising LP Fee Share to 88% and Cutting Daily CAKE Emission

current_state.zh: PancakeSwap's Kitchen has proposed raising the LP share of v3 and Infinity swap fees to 88% across all 11 chains and cutting daily CAKE emissions roughly 69% from 22,500 to 7,000, pending a Snapshot vote with implementation targeted for November 2026 through January 2027.
